exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to describe, to depict, to portray (to represent in words)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: на́дпись — inscription, writing, label; опи́сывать — to describe, to depict, to portray (to represent in words); описа́ние — description; пи́сьменный — written.

**списке** — спи́сок: list, register, roll (register or roll of paper consisting of an enumeration or compilation of a set of possible items); handwritten or handpainted copy (especially of a manuscript or a religious icon). Wiktionary: с- + писа́ть + -ок.

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: подписа́ть — to sign (one's own name); вы́писать — to sign out; запи́сывать — to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing); ру́копись — manuscript.
